title: A5: archiving a project the assistant did not create needs the person's yes; a session token cannot give it
description: Asked to archive a project it did not create, the assistant's archive_workspace returns needs_confirmation and a card appears. Allowed path: the person's cookie accepts and the project is archived with its files and records intact. Rejected path: POST /api/personal-agent/proposals/{id}/accept with the assistant session's token (and with a device credential) is refused.
preconditions: Assistant set up; a project the person owns that the assistant did not create.

steps.value: 把『旧博客』收起来吧，不用了

steps.target: POST /api/personal-agent/proposals/{id}/accept with the assistant session's bearer token
button named 好的 on the proposal card
the project's folder and its chats

assertions.target: proposal card asking to put the project away, with 好的 and 不用了

cleanup: Restore the project (restore is automatic for the assistant, or the Workspaces page).
